console.name: genai
console.title: GenAI
console.description: The model calls, agent runs and tool calls of the Camel AI components

content.label: query
content.description: Whether to add the message content to the listed calls (only recorded at level full)

id.label: query
id.description: The id of one call (an agent run, a model call or a tool call) to answer with its content

limit.label: query
limit.description: The number of the newest top-level calls to list

recording.description: Whether the calls are recorded: while the dev console is enabled

level.description: The observability level: basic, detailed or full

contentMaxLength.description: The cap on each recorded text

errors.description: The calls that failed since start

inputTokens.description: The input tokens of the model calls since start

outputTokens.description: The output tokens of the model calls since start

cachedInputTokens.description: The input tokens read from the cache of the provider since start

provider.description: The provider, such as openai or ollama

model.description: The model, the response model when known

cachedInputTokens.description: The input tokens read from the cache of the provider

durationMs.description: The time of the model calls in millis

models.description: The model calls since start per provider and model

operation.description: The GenAI operation: invoke_agent, chat, embeddings, ...

name.description: The name of the call, such as chat gpt-4o

agentName.description: The agent of an agent run

timestamp.description: When the call started, in epoch millis

running.description: Whether the call is still running

durationMs.description: The time of the call in millis, when it ended

inputTokens.description: The input tokens (of its model calls, for an agent run)

outputTokens.description: The output tokens (of its model calls, for an agent run)

cachedInputTokens.description: The input tokens read from the cache (of its model calls, for an agent run)

finishReason.description: The finish reason, such as stop or tool_calls

error.description: The exception type when the call failed

modelCalls.description: The model calls of an agent run

toolCalls.description: The tool calls of an agent run

modelMs.description: The time of the model calls of an agent run in millis

toolMs.description: The time of the tool calls of an agent run in millis

parentId.description: The id of the call it was made in

toolName.description: The tool of a tool call

toolCallId.description: The id the model gave to the tool call

model.description: The model of a model call

timestamp.description: When the call started, in epoch millis

running.description: Whether the call is still running

cachedInputTokens.description: The input tokens read from the cache

finishReason.description: The finish reason, such as stop or tool_calls

error.description: The exception type when the call failed

steps.description: The calls made inside this one, in the order they started

droppedSteps.description: The steps not kept, beyond the cap per call
